messages:
zara: FYI new hire Ana (F-1) applied for OPT in May; start date in offer is 2024-07-22. DSO will release SEVIS on 2024-07-09 per candidate. can we confirm what onboarding can be completed pre-EAD?

ivan: short answer: orientation and paperwork yes, paid work and benefits no until EAD active. we should add clear language to the offer and schedule i-9 once EAD is in hand.

ana: thanks! i'm hoping EAD arrives early but my receipt notice shows 5/02 filing. DSO will release SEVIS 7/09. happy to do all forms and training before my EAD.

immigration-vendor: checklist for people-ops and candidate:
- candidate uploads passport + I-20 + USCIS receipt to secure portal
- DSO confirms SEVIS release (we'll monitor)
- once EAD issued, candidate sends EAD image and I-94 for i-9
we can run a preliminary eligibility review now but cannot clear payroll until EAD/I-9 verified.

people-ops-bot: [TASK] Create onboarding packet: "Ana - OPT" assigned to zara, due 2024-07-10

zara: action plan: 1) update offer addendum: unpaid orientation and employment contingent on proof of work authorization (ivan can draft). 2) schedule virtual orientation 7/22 as unpaid. 3) set up reminders for 7/10 and 7/12 to check SEVIS/EAD status.

ivan: drafting addendum now. proposed language: "Orientation and introductory training may occur before proof of authorization; compensation and benefits enrollment will begin upon employee providing valid work authorization (e.g., EAD) and completing Form I-9." any objections?

payroll: that language works. note for payroll: once we receive EAD and I-9, retro pay to the EAD effective date is possible if documented; otherwise payroll will start on verified EAD start. send all verified docs to payroll@redwood.com.

ana: i've uploaded passport + I-20 + receipt to the portal and messaged my DSO to confirm SEVIS release on 7/9. will post confirmation here once they do. appreciate the clarity!

zara: thanks. summary for record: orientation scheduled (unpaid) 2024-07-22, employment start contingent on EAD/I-9. zara will close the loop after DSO confirmation.

people-ops-bot: [REMINDER] Check candidate portal for Ana on 2024-07-10
